scope.rule: Every remaining workflow consumer of these legacy PAT-style credentials must have an explicit K3_RESIDUAL row with the reason it cannot be migrated to the governed Contents-read App route.

residuals.reason: seal_downstream installs its payload as a long-lived downstream repository Actions secret. A GitHub App installation token expires in about an hour and must never be sealed as the downstream credential.
residuals.why_app_installation_token_not_sufficien: The governed App route mints short-lived Contents-read tokens for current-run reads only; this job's output is a durable encrypted secret payload for another repository.
residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Replace the downstream bundle-secret architecture with a registered non-secret or short-lived proof path, or remove the downstream secret requirement entirely.
residuals.safe_current_boundary: The selector runs with --legacy-only and refuses a complete App pair here, so this residual cannot accidentally seal an about-to-expire installation token.

residuals.reason: The protected newsletter ruleset endpoint requires ruleset/admin authority that the governed Contents-read App intentionally does not hold.
residuals.why_app_installation_token_not_sufficien: Contents:Read can fetch repository contents but cannot read repos/rexcoleman/newsletter/rulesets/19564990.
residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Introduce a registered host-OAuth or GitHub App authority with the minimal ruleset-read permission, counted under FA-3, then update the ruleset fetch to that authority.
residuals.safe_current_boundary: The response is normalized immediately and refusal is before signing if the token is absent, expired, or returns an unexpected ruleset shape.

residuals.reason: The s212 recovery probe intentionally observes and replaces legacy hosted credentials; removing the legacy name from the probe would blind the recovery rail to the state it is meant to repair.
residuals.why_app_installation_token_not_sufficien: The probe must distinguish legacy-token absence, presence, and replacement readiness; an App-only token would not exercise the legacy secret slot.
residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Retire this probe row only after the s212 recovery successor is replaced by an App-only recovery path and no hosted legacy bundle token remains.
residuals.safe_current_boundary: The probe prints presence and typed refusals only; it never discloses the token value.

residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Retire this probe row only after a registered ruleset-read authority replaces REA_RULESET_READ_TOKEN and the recovery probe validates that successor.

residuals.reason: Copying the issuer signing key into the renewal environment writes Actions secrets; the governed Contents-read App intentionally has no secrets-write permission.
residuals.why_app_installation_token_not_sufficien: Contents:Read cannot call the GitHub environment-secrets write API.
residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Introduce a registered host-OAuth or GitHub App authority with minimal secrets-write permission, counted under FA-3, and prove the same read/write/postcheck boundary.
residuals.safe_current_boundary: The workflow probes write scope before mutation and refuses unless the observed updated_at proves this run wrote the target secret.

residuals.reason: The optional s217 provisioning mode writes the governed App pair into research_enforcement_activation repository secrets; the governed Contents-read App intentionally has no secrets-write permission.
residuals.why_app_installation_token_not_sufficien: Contents:Read cannot write repository Actions secrets.
residuals.required_authority_to_retire: Introduce a registered host-OAuth or GitHub App authority with minimal secrets-write permission, counted under FA-3, or retire the provisioning mode after a new enrollment path supersedes it.
residuals.safe_current_boundary: The mutating step is gated by workflow_dispatch input provision_rea=true and refuses if the secret-write credential is absent.
